Screened Porches Built for Coastal Living

Custom screened-in porches with clean lines, solid aluminum framing, and a finished look designed to complement your home. We turn covered outdoor spaces into comfortable places for relaxing, dining, entertaining, and enjoying the coastal breeze with fewer bugs.

Aluminum Extrusion Systems

Clean, durable framing in white or bronze, configured to fit the openings and architecture of your porch.

Existing Porch Enclosures

Transform an existing covered porch into a screened outdoor room while keeping the space open, bright, and connected to your home.

Designed Around Your Home

About Simply Enclosures

Focused on Better Outdoor Living

Simply Enclosures is a Grand Strand specialist focused on screened-in porches for coastal homes. Our goal is straightforward: create a clean, comfortable enclosure that fits the home and gives homeowners more ways to enjoy the outdoor space they already have.

What You Can Expect

Free on-site estimates, clear communication, careful measuring and planning, and a finished enclosure designed around the home.

Simple From Start to Finish

Simple steps, clear communication, and a straightforward path from the first conversation to the finished enclosure.

Request an Estimate

Tell us about your porch and what you want from the space.

Measure & Plan

We visit the home, measure the openings, review the options, and plan the enclosure.

Installation & Walkthrough

We install the enclosure and review the finished space with you when the work is complete.

Serving the Grand Strand

Simply Enclosures serves homeowners throughout the Grand Strand area, including Myrtle Beach, Surfside Beach, Garden City, Murrells Inlet, Pawleys Island, Conway, North Myrtle Beach, and nearby communities.
